verdict.rationale: Linear supports asynchronous team communication via comments on issues, documents, and text/images, and @mentions across the workspace, which lets teammates converse in context of planned work, but there's no evidence of real-time chat/messaging (e.g., DMs, channels) inside Linear itself—communication with Slack is only referenced as an external integration for updates. Missing for 10: dedicated chat/messaging feature, threaded conversations beyond comments, evidence of synchronous team chat.
